sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. Preserve source currentness debt for the hands-free rule and its explicitly referenced statutory exceptions. Do not turn hands-free permission into a claim of distraction-free use. Hydroplaning speeds and headlight-distance speed examples are not universal safe thresholds and remain withheld pending factual review. Physical79 requests twice-normal wet-road spacing while physical71 suggests four seconds; neither is a ceiling. The physical82 five-foot approach instruction and interpreting a withdrawn cane as an instruction to proceed require disability-safety review and are not taught. Dated age, peer-pressure, crash and texting-risk figures, including a nonofficial website statistic, remain unasserted. Image-only passing and backing diagrams are deferred. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.

corpus_stability.reason: Registered handbook snapshot only; effective-date, rights, source freshness and independent factual review debts remain. No unsupported revision-frequency claim.
